proposal.reason: Main change is CI pipeline behavior: source-sanity and daily workflows switch from committed daily CSV inputs to prepare-time JSON case generation, add stricter artifact/NAS cache probe+publish+SHA validation, expand grouped execution policy (including cross-rack/8-node handling), strengthen recovery/reconciliation/reporting, and publish an XLSX performance artifact; file deletions/renames of daily CSV assets and related docs/tests are supporting this same CI execution path.
